modsync.title: ModSync
modsync.installed: Mods updated. A game restart is required.
modsync.failed.hint: Could not sync with %s. Check client.serverAddress / client.secret in config/modsync-common.toml and that the server's sync port is open.
modsync.restart.auto: The game will restart automatically in a few seconds.
modsync.restart.manual: Automatic restart is unavailable. Close the game and start it again.
modsync.identity.hint: The identity key of %s differs from the one saved at your first connection. Someone may be impersonating the server. If the admin reinstalled the server or reset its key, you can forget the old key.
modsync.reconnecting: Connection lost. Reconnecting and resuming the download (%s/%s)...
